usedFor: Growby sends template messages by phone number, so “Send Template Message” reaches people through your Growby account.

bestTemplate.name: “New Form Response” in Google Forms, then “Send Template Message” in Growby
bestTemplate.why: A new form response can start a template message to that person.

watchOut: “Send Template Message” reaches someone outside, so it waits in Needs you for approval first.
